description.text: , near-total darkness presses around the low, wide silhouette of the black sports car. The polished floor is almost invisible until the headlights snap alight, throwing twin cones forward that cut a steep bar of light across the concrete and rake the carbon-fibre weave of the front bodywork. Dust motes drift through the beams; reflections gather under the nose and along the fenders. The car sits still at first, its shape resolving out of the black as the bright edges climb the hood and the showroom walls emerge in a cool, cinematic half-light. The camera holds a static shot, letting the sudden wash of headlights do the work, while the surrounding floor stays empty and open beyond the light.
A sharp electric click and a high hum as the headlights ignite.
A low drivetrain rumble wakes beneath the car.
The camera holds a static shot.
The shot cuts to a medium-wide view as the black sports car pulls forward across

, rolling out of the shadowed end and into the light. Its carbon-fibre panels take a long travelling sheen; the floor reflections slide back beneath the nose while the headlight beams sweep ahead and open a path across the polished concrete. The car's movement is smooth and deliberate, gaining a little momentum as it leaves the darkest part of the room. The camera tracks with the subject with small amplitude at slow speed, keeping the car's front three-quarter shape prominent and allowing the empty floor and cool showroom light to stretch around it. The engine note rises under load, tyres whisper across the polished concrete, and the car continues forward until it is fully revealed in the lit open floor.
The car eases forward out of the shadowed end of the showroom.
The engine note rises under load as the car moves.
Tyres roll smoothly across the polished concrete.
